classification.classification_reason: The article discusses the demolition of a house belonging to a former Trinamool Congress strongman in West Bengal, which is a political event involving corruption and criminal activities.

content.title: Parts of former TMC strongman Jahangir Khan's house demolished
content.caption: Former Trinamool Congress strongman Jahangir Khan's house demolished in Falta, West Bengal.

slides.heading: Former Trinamool Congress Strongman's House Demolished
slides.text: Former Trinamool Congress strongman Jahangir Khan's house demolished in Falta, West Bengal.
slides.image_search_query: former tmc strongman house demolished India

slides.heading: Background
slides.text: Jahangir Khan, a former Trinamool Congress strongman, was arrested on July 8 for extortion, murder, and criminal intimidation. He dropped out of the race just ahead of the repoll.

slides.heading: Details
slides.text: The district administration demolished an unauthorised portion of a home belonging to Jahangir Khan in Falta, West Bengal. The building exceeded two storeys and lacked approval.
